intent: A black basalt plate set whose long gold-capped horns sweep wide as its single silhouette, with a burning ember core and molten seams carried from the chest over the gold-ridged pauldrons, reading at the high camera as a horned black-and-gold shape with hot orange lines.
requests: A cone or tapered horn part: the long horns are straight boxes, and a taper would make them read as horns rather than swept posts.
A gold that still catches light under the mood preset: with environment specular off, the ember-gold trim can only be painted flat and reads bronze at distance.
